notes.text: Codification Section, Pub. L. 106–425, § 2, Nov. 1, 2000, 114 Stat. 1890, which set out congressional findings and purposes, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.
Short TitlePub. L. 106–425, § 1, Nov. 1, 2000, 114 Stat. 1890, provided that Pub. L. 106–425, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Santo Domingo Pueblo Claims Settlement Act of 2000”.
